description.zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID。
description.en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID on the **Application Management > Basic Information** page in the EDAS console.

description.zh: 缓冲请求数，流控效果为快速失败时需要设置。
description.en: The number of burst requests. This parameter is required when the throttling behavior is set to fast failure.

description.zh: 流控效果，0表示快速失败，2表示排队等待。
description.en:
The throttling behavior. Valid values:
- 0: fast failure
- 2: queuing.
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Default value: false.

description.zh: 超时时间，流控效果为排队等待时需要设置，单位毫秒。
description.en: The timeout period, in milliseconds. This parameter is required when the throttling behavior is set to queuing.

description.zh: 统计维度，0表示并发数，1表示通过请求数。
description.en:
The statistical dimension. Valid values:
- 0: concurrency
- 1: pass request count.

description.zh:
参数位置索引，埋点传入参数的索引位置。对应`SphU.entry(xxx,args)`中的参数索引位置。

例如：`SphU.entry(resourceName,Entry Type.IN,1,paramA,paramB)`埋点中，`paramA`的参数索引是0，`paramB`的参数索引是1。
description.en:
The index of the parameter position, which is the index position of the parameter passed in through instrumentation. This corresponds to the parameter index position in `SphU.entry(xxx,args)`.

For example, in the instrumentation `SphU.entry(resourceName,Entry Type.IN,1,paramA,paramB)`, the parameter index of `paramA` is 0, and the parameter index of `paramB` is 1.

description.zh: 资源名。不能超过1024个字符，且该资源名需要与接口详情页面的资源名称相对应。
description.en: The resource name. The name can be up to 1024 characters in length and must correspond to the resource name on the API details page.

description.zh: 热点规则中针对每个热点参数的阈值，取值范围为≥0的整数。
description.en: The threshold for each hot parameter in the hot parameter rule. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.
